def_id: Pelaku atau hal yang dibicarakan dalam kalimat. Biasanya berupa noun atau pronoun dan berada sebelum verb.
def_en: The person or thing a sentence is about. Usually a noun or pronoun placed before the verb.
analogy_id: Subject itu sopir mobil. Tanpa sopir, mobil (kalimat) tidak bisa jalan.
analogy_en: The subject is the driver. Without a driver, the car (the sentence) goes nowhere.

def_id: Kata yang menyatakan tindakan atau keadaan. Setiap clause wajib punya satu verb utama yang sudah ber-tense.
def_en: A word showing an action or state. Every clause needs one main verb that carries tense.
analogy_id: Verb itu mesin mobil. Sopir sudah duduk, tapi tanpa mesin mobil tetap diam.
analogy_en: The verb is the engine. Even with a driver seated, the car won't move without one.

def_id: Kata kerja yang membantu main verb membentuk tense, passive, atau pertanyaan: be, have, do, dan modal.
def_en: A helping verb (be, have, do, modals) that works with the main verb to form tenses, the passive, or questions.
analogy_id: Auxiliary itu kernet: membantu sopir, tapi menentukan bentuk kata kerja yang boleh naik.
analogy_en: The auxiliary is the conductor: it helps the driver and decides which verb form may board.

def_id: Kata kerja yang membawa arti utama, berdiri sesudah auxiliary bila ada.
def_en: The verb carrying the core meaning; it follows any auxiliary.
analogy_id: Kalau auxiliary itu kernet, main verb adalah mesin yang benar-benar bekerja.
analogy_en: If the auxiliary is the conductor, the main verb is the engine doing the real work.

def_id: Noun atau pronoun yang menerima tindakan dari verb, biasanya setelah verb.
def_en: The noun or pronoun that receives the verb's action, usually after the verb.
analogy_id: Object itu penumpang yang diantar mobil sampai tujuan.
analogy_en: The object is the passenger the car carries to its destination.

def_id: Kata atau frasa yang melengkapi arti subject setelah linking verb seperti be, seem, become.
def_en: A word or phrase that completes the subject after linking verbs such as be, seem, or become.
analogy_id: Complement itu stiker nama di pintu mobil: menjelaskan siapa sopirnya.
analogy_en: A complement is the name sticker on the car door, telling you more about the driver.

def_id: Verb yang tidak menunjukkan tindakan tetapi menghubungkan subject dengan keterangannya: be, seem, become, look, feel.
def_en: A verb that links the subject to a description rather than showing action: be, seem, become, look, feel.
analogy_id: Linking verb itu jembatan, bukan mesin: menghubungkan sopir dengan keterangannya.
analogy_en: A linking verb is a bridge, not an engine: it connects the driver to a description.

def_id: Kata untuk orang, tempat, benda, atau gagasan. Bisa menjadi subject atau object.
def_en: A word naming a person, place, thing, or idea. It can be a subject or an object.
analogy_id: Noun itu muatan atau penumpang yang bisa dibawa ke mana saja dalam kalimat.
analogy_en: Nouns are the cargo and passengers that can sit almost anywhere in the sentence.

def_id: Kata pengganti noun: he, she, it, they, him, them, its, their.
def_en: A word that replaces a noun: he, she, it, they, him, them, its, their.
example: Maya lost __her__ notes, so __she__ borrowed mine.
analogy_id: Pronoun itu nama panggilan: tidak perlu menyebut nama lengkap berulang kali.
analogy_en: A pronoun is a nickname, so you don't repeat the full name every time.

def_id: Kata yang menerangkan noun. Biasanya sebelum noun atau setelah linking verb.
def_en: A word that describes a noun, usually before the noun or after a linking verb.
analogy_id: Adjective itu cat mobil: memberi warna pada noun.
analogy_en: An adjective is the paint job: it colours the noun.

def_id: Kata yang menerangkan verb, adjective, atau adverb lain. Banyak berakhiran -ly.
def_en: A word that describes a verb, an adjective, or another adverb. Many end in -ly.
analogy_id: Adverb itu gaya menyetir: pelan, cepat, hati-hati, menerangkan cara mesin bekerja.
analogy_en: An adverb is the driving style: slow, fast, careful. It describes how the engine runs.

def_id: Kata yang menunjukkan hubungan tempat, waktu, atau arah, dan selalu diikuti noun/pronoun: in, on, at, despite, because of.
def_en: A word showing place, time, or direction, always followed by a noun or pronoun: in, on, at, despite, because of.
example: We studied __in__ the library __despite__ the noise.
analogy_id: Preposition itu rambu jalan: menunjukkan posisi dan arah, tapi butuh noun di depannya.
analogy_en: A preposition is a road sign: it shows position and direction and always points to a noun.

def_id: Kata penghubung kata, frasa, atau clause: and, but, because, although. Conjunction yang menghubungkan clause harus diikuti subject + verb.
def_en: A word joining words, phrases, or clauses: and, but, because, although. Clause-joining conjunctions need a subject + verb after them.
example: She stayed home __because__ it was raining.
analogy_id: Conjunction itu gandengan: menyambung dua mobil (dua clause) agar berjalan bersama.
analogy_en: A conjunction is a tow hitch: it links two cars (two clauses) so they travel together.

def_id: a/an untuk noun tunggal yang belum spesifik; the untuk yang sudah spesifik.
def_en: a/an for a non-specific singular noun; the for something specific.
analogy_id: Article itu plat nomor: a/an = mobil apa saja, the = mobil yang itu.
analogy_en: Articles are number plates: a/an = any car, the = that particular car.

def_id: Kata sebelum noun yang menentukan jumlah atau kepemilikan: this, those, my, some, every.
def_en: A word before a noun that shows which or how many: this, those, my, some, every.
analogy_id: Determiner itu label di bagasi: menandai milik siapa atau berapa banyak.
analogy_en: A determiner is the luggage tag: whose it is or how many.

def_id: Kata jumlah seperti many, much, few, little, a number of, an amount of.
def_en: Quantity words such as many, much, few, little, a number of, an amount of.
analogy_id: many/few untuk kelereng (bisa dihitung), much/little untuk air (tidak bisa dihitung).
analogy_en: many/few are for marbles you can count; much/little are for water you can't.

def_id: Bentuk verb + -ing yang berfungsi sebagai noun, misalnya sebagai subject atau setelah preposition.
def_en: A verb + -ing used as a noun, for example as a subject or after a preposition.
analogy_id: Gerund itu mesin yang dicopot lalu dipajang: bentuknya verb, fungsinya benda.
analogy_en: A gerund is an engine on display: verb-shaped, but used as a thing.

def_id: Bentuk to + V1, sering menyatakan tujuan atau mengikuti verb tertentu (want, plan, decide).
def_en: The form to + base verb, often showing purpose or following verbs like want, plan, decide.
analogy_id: Infinitive itu mesin yang masih di kotak dengan label 'to': belum dipasang ke mobil.
analogy_en: An infinitive is an engine still boxed and labelled 'to', not yet installed.

def_id: Kelompok kata yang punya subject dan verb sendiri.
def_en: A group of words with its own subject and verb.
analogy_id: Clause itu satu mobil lengkap: ada sopir dan ada mesin.
analogy_en: A clause is one complete car: it has a driver and an engine.

def_id: Kelompok kata tanpa pasangan subject + verb lengkap.
def_en: A group of words without a full subject + verb pair.
analogy_id: Phrase itu gerbong tanpa mesin: harus ditarik oleh clause.
analogy_en: A phrase is a carriage with no engine; a clause has to pull it.

def_id: Clause yang bisa berdiri sendiri sebagai kalimat lengkap.
def_en: A clause that can stand alone as a complete sentence.
analogy_id: Independent clause itu mobil yang bisa jalan sendiri di jalan raya.
analogy_en: An independent clause is a car that can drive on the highway alone.

def_id: Clause yang diawali kata seperti because, although, which, that dan tidak bisa berdiri sendiri.
def_en: A clause beginning with words like because, although, which, that; it cannot stand alone.
example: __Because the road was closed__, we walked.
analogy_id: Dependent clause itu mobil derek yang harus menempel pada mobil induk.
analogy_en: A dependent clause is a towed car that must be hitched to a main car.

def_id: Clause yang menerangkan noun, diawali who, which, that, whose, where.
def_en: A clause that describes a noun, starting with who, which, that, whose, or where.
example: The scientist __who discovered the vaccine__ spoke today.
analogy_id: Relative clause itu kartu identitas yang ditempel pada noun.
analogy_en: A relative clause is an ID card clipped onto a noun.

def_id: Clause yang berfungsi sebagai noun (subject atau object), diawali what, that, whether, how.
def_en: A clause that acts as a noun (subject or object), starting with what, that, whether, how.
analogy_id: Noun clause itu satu mobil utuh yang diangkut di atas truk lain sebagai muatan.
analogy_en: A noun clause is a whole car carried on a truck as cargo.

def_id: Clause yang menerangkan waktu, sebab, syarat, atau pertentangan: when, because, if, although.
def_en: A clause showing time, reason, condition, or contrast: when, because, if, although.
example: __If you review daily__, the rules will stick.
analogy_id: Adverb clause itu GPS: memberi info kapan, kenapa, dan dengan syarat apa mobil jalan.
analogy_en: An adverb clause is the GPS: when, why, and under what condition the car moves.

def_id: Relative atau adverb clause yang dipendekkan dengan menghapus subject + be, menyisakan V-ing atau V3.
def_en: A shortened relative or adverb clause with subject + be removed, leaving V-ing or V3.
example: The data __collected last year__ were reliable.
analogy_id: Reduced clause itu mobil versi mini: sopir dan kernet turun, mesinnya saja yang tersisa.
analogy_en: A reduced clause is a mini car: the driver and conductor step out, only the engine stays.

def_id: Kata atau frasa yang menjelaskan bagian lain kalimat. Harus dekat dengan kata yang dijelaskan.
def_en: A word or phrase describing another part of the sentence. It should sit next to what it describes.
example: __Tired after the exam__, the students slept.
analogy_id: Modifier itu lampu sorot: harus diarahkan ke benda yang benar.
analogy_en: A modifier is a spotlight: point it at the right object.

def_id: Noun phrase di samping noun lain yang memberi nama atau penjelasan ulang, biasanya diapit koma.
def_en: A noun phrase next to another noun that renames it, usually set off by commas.
example: Dr. Lee, __a marine biologist__, led the trip.
analogy_id: Appositive itu papan nama kedua di mobil yang sama.
analogy_en: An appositive is a second name badge on the same car.

def_id: Bentuk kata kerja tanpa tambahan: go, write, study. Dipakai setelah modal dan to.
def_en: The plain verb form: go, write, study. Used after modals and to.
analogy_id: V1 itu mesin standar pabrik, belum dimodifikasi.
analogy_en: V1 is the factory-standard engine, unmodified.

def_id: Bentuk kata kerja untuk simple past: went, wrote, studied.
def_en: The verb form for the simple past: went, wrote, studied.
analogy_id: V2 itu mesin yang sudah dipakai kemarin: menunjukkan cerita lampau.
analogy_en: V2 is yesterday's engine: it tells a past story.

def_id: Bentuk ketiga: gone, written, studied. Dipakai setelah have/has/had dan be (passive).
def_en: The third form: gone, written, studied. Used after have/has/had and after be in the passive.
analogy_id: V3 itu tiket khusus: hanya kernet have atau be yang mau menerimanya.
analogy_en: V3 is a special ticket only the have or be conductors will accept.

def_id: Bentuk verb + -ing setelah be untuk continuous, atau sebagai adjective aktif.
def_en: The verb + -ing form after be for continuous tenses, or as an active adjective.
example: The students are __preparing__ for the test.
analogy_id: V-ing itu mesin yang sedang menyala sekarang.
analogy_en: V-ing is an engine that is running right now.

def_id: Bentuk verb yang menunjukkan waktu kejadian: present, past, future, beserta perfect/continuous.
def_en: The verb form that shows time: present, past, future, plus perfect and continuous.
example: She __will present__ her findings next week.
analogy_id: Tense itu jam di dasbor: menentukan kapan mobil berjalan.
analogy_en: Tense is the dashboard clock: it tells when the car is moving.

def_id: Untuk fakta, kebiasaan, jadwal. Subject tunggal (he/she/it) memakai verb + s/es.
def_en: For facts, habits, and schedules. A singular subject (he/she/it) takes verb + s/es.
analogy_id: Simple present itu rute bus harian: selalu sama setiap hari.
analogy_en: The simple present is a daily bus route: the same every day.

def_id: have/has + V3. Kejadian lampau yang masih berhubungan dengan sekarang.
def_en: have/has + V3. A past action still connected to the present.
example: The city __has built__ three new parks.
analogy_id: Present perfect itu odometer: jarak lampau yang tetap tercatat sampai sekarang.
analogy_en: The present perfect is the odometer: past distance still on record today.

def_id: had + V3. Kejadian yang selesai sebelum kejadian lampau lain.
def_en: had + V3. An action finished before another past action.
example: The train __had left__ when we arrived.
analogy_id: Past perfect itu mobil yang sudah berangkat duluan sebelum kita tiba di halte.
analogy_en: The past perfect is the car that left before we reached the stop.

def_id: can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must. Selalu diikuti V1.
def_en: can, could, will, would, shall, should, may, might, must. Always followed by the base form.
analogy_id: Modal itu kernet yang hanya menerima V1 polos, tanpa -s, -ed, atau -ing.
analogy_en: A modal is a conductor who only accepts a plain V1: no -s, -ed, or -ing.

def_id: be + V3. Subject menerima tindakan, bukan melakukan.
def_en: be + V3. The subject receives the action instead of doing it.
example: The bridge __was designed__ by a local firm.
analogy_id: Passive itu penumpang yang duduk di kursi sopir: ia di depan, tapi bukan yang menyetir.
analogy_en: The passive puts the passenger in the driver's seat: in front, but not driving.

def_id: Subject melakukan tindakan.
def_en: The subject performs the action.
analogy_id: Active itu sopir asli yang benar-benar menyetir.
analogy_en: The active voice is the real driver at the wheel.

def_id: Subject tunggal memakai verb tunggal, subject jamak memakai verb jamak. Frasa of di tengah tidak mengubah subject.
def_en: A singular subject takes a singular verb; a plural subject takes a plural verb. An of-phrase in between doesn't change the subject.
example: The list of names __is__ on the wall.
analogy_id: Sopir satu orang hanya pakai satu kursi. Penumpang (frasa of) tidak dihitung sebagai sopir.
analogy_en: One driver takes one seat. Passengers in the of-phrase don't count as drivers.

def_id: Bagian yang dihubungkan and/or/but harus berbentuk sama: noun-noun, V-ing-V-ing, adjective-adjective.
def_en: Items joined by and/or/but must share the same form: noun-noun, V-ing-V-ing, adjective-adjective.
analogy_id: Struktur paralel itu rangkaian gerbong kereta: semua harus berukuran sama agar bisa disambung.
analogy_en: Parallel structure is a train: every carriage must be the same gauge to connect.

def_id: adjective + -er atau more + adjective, diikuti than.
def_en: adjective + -er or more + adjective, followed by than.
example: This route is __shorter than__ that one.
analogy_id: Comparative itu adu dua mobil: mana yang lebih cepat.
analogy_en: A comparative is a two-car race: which one is faster.

def_id: the + adjective-est atau the most + adjective, untuk tiga atau lebih.
def_en: the + adjective-est or the most + adjective, for three or more.
example: It is __the oldest__ building on campus.
analogy_id: Superlative itu juara balapan dari semua peserta.
analogy_en: A superlative is the race winner among all the cars.

def_id: Noun yang punya bentuk jamak dan bisa dihitung: books, ideas. Memakai many/few/a number of.
def_en: A noun with a plural form that can be counted: books, ideas. Use many/few/a number of.
analogy_id: Countable itu kelereng: bisa dihitung satu per satu.
analogy_en: Countable nouns are marbles: you can count them one by one.

def_id: Noun tanpa bentuk jamak: information, water, research. Memakai much/little/an amount of.
def_en: A noun with no plural form: information, water, research. Use much/little/an amount of.
analogy_id: Uncountable itu air: diukur, bukan dihitung butirnya.
analogy_en: Uncountable nouns are water: you measure them, you don't count drops.

def_id: Akhiran yang menentukan kelas kata: -tion/-ment (noun), -ous/-ive (adjective), -ly (adverb), -ize/-en (verb).
def_en: An ending that marks the part of speech: -tion/-ment (noun), -ous/-ive (adjective), -ly (adverb), -ize/-en (verb).
analogy_id: Suffix itu seragam: dari seragamnya kita tahu kata itu bekerja sebagai apa.
analogy_en: A suffix is a uniform: it shows what job the word is doing.

def_id: Auxiliary diletakkan sebelum subject setelah kata negatif di awal: Never, Rarely, Not only, Seldom.
def_en: Auxiliary placed before the subject after a negative opener: Never, Rarely, Not only, Seldom.
analogy_id: Inversi itu kernet yang naik duluan sebelum sopir saat ada rambu 'Never/Rarely'.
analogy_en: Inversion: the conductor boards before the driver when a 'Never/Rarely' sign appears.

def_id: Pasangan tetap: either…or, neither…nor, both…and, not only…but also.
def_en: Fixed pairs: either…or, neither…nor, both…and, not only…but also.
example: __Neither__ the map __nor__ the guide was helpful.
analogy_id: Correlative itu sepasang sepatu: kiri dan kanan harus pasangan yang benar.
analogy_en: Correlatives are a pair of shoes: left and right must match.

def_id: Kata atau subject yang diulang tanpa perlu, misalnya subject ganda atau 'return back'.
def_en: Words repeated unnecessarily, such as a double subject or 'return back'.
analogy_id: Redundancy itu dua sopir di satu kursi: tidak muat dan membingungkan.
analogy_en: Redundancy is two drivers in one seat: it doesn't fit and confuses everyone.
